204.description: Arrival recorded (or was already recorded — an idempotent redelivery). If this arrival completed the order's required line set, the order's PACK task has been created. No response body.

400.description: The request body is malformed JSON, a required field is missing or empty, or a field value is invalid (e.g. a task type outside the TaskType enum). `instance` is omitted: this is a bare collection-create endpoint with no path segment identifying a specific resource.

schema.description: RFC 7807 (Problem Details for HTTP APIs) error response, used for every error this API returns. See https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807.

type.description: A URI identifying the error category. Does not need to resolve to a real page — it is an identifier, unique per distinct error category in this service.

status.description: Duplicates the HTTP status code, per RFC 7807.

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced the error. Omitted for a validation error on a bare collection-create endpoint (`POST /tasks`, `POST /stations`, `POST /rebin/arrivals`) whose path has no segment identifying a specific resource.
